description: Owner authentication of a tenant vault: returns the EXACT EIP-712 VaultOwner to sign for one act — link (the first owner, by the vault's own tenant: signed by the wallet being linked), rotate (current owner hands over + new owner accepts, effective after the rotation delay), recover (the recovery key names a new owner who accepts, after the longer delay) or cancel (the current owner cancels a pending change) — with the nonce, the effective time, who must sign, the POST /v1/vault/owner body and the cockpit link. It never signs.

owner.description: the 0x wallet the act installs (link, rotate, recover); omitted for cancel (the current owner)

name: taifoon_vault_owner
